name: compute_pass_finish_basic
description: Opens a command encoder, records an empty compute pass, ends it, and finishes the encoder.
reason: The encoder and pass scopes are opened and closed in the valid order, so the command buffer is produced without any state violation.
notes: This fixture intentionally avoids pipeline and dispatch requirements and exists to validate the happy-path recorder lifecycle for BeginCommandEncoder, BeginComputePass, EndComputePass, and FinishCommandEncoder.
